entry.summary: STRIQ recasts annotation-free ultrasound plane quality control as subspace-guided consistency measurement via registration. Uses variance-driven anchors distilled from unlabeled data.

entry.title: A Tertiary Review of Large Language Model-Based Code Generating Tasks: Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions

author.name: Muslim Chochlov, Michael English, Jim Buckley

entry.summary: Tertiary review of LLM-based code generation tasks consolidating secondary evidence on effects, scenarios, integration challenges, and future directions. Synthesizes meta-level publication landscape.

entry.title: Toward a Benchmark for Controllable Simulation of Imperfect Students with Large Language Models

author.name: Alexander Apartsin, Omri Sason, Yehudit Aperstein

entry.summary: Benchmark framework for testing whether LLMs can be steered via prompting to simulate students with specific skill profiles. Targets teacher education with controllable imperfection.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Over Architectural Complexity: Broad-Coverage PII Detection on PIIBench with DeBERTa

author.name: Pritesh Jha

entry.summary: Studies DeBERTa fine-tuning vs hierarchical and curriculum extensions on PIIBench for broad-coverage PII detection across 82 entity types and 10 sources. Finds direct fine-tuning outperforms complex variants.

entry.title: Conditional KRR: Injecting Unpenalized Features into Kernel Methods with Applications to Kernel Thresholding

author.name: Rustem Takhanov, Zhenisbek Assylbekov

entry.summary: Conditional KRR injects unpenalized features into kernel methods with applications to kernel thresholding via CPD kernels and native spaces.

entry.title: ChainzRule: Sample-Efficient, Robust Deep Learning Across Tabular, NLP, and Vision Tasks

author.name: Rowan Martnishn

entry.summary: ChainzRule replaces activations with learnable polynomial layers governed by Jacobian penalty Differential Regularization. Claims sample-efficient robust performance across tabular/NLP/vision.

entry.title: Synheart Capacity: A Theory-Driven Physiological Representation of Cognitive Capacity Dynamics from Wearable Signals

author.name: Yisak Debele, Henok Ademtew, Israel Goytom

entry.summary: Theory-driven multimodal framework models cognitive capacity from wearable cardiac (HRV) and electrodermal signals as 2D representation of effort and stress.

entry.title: A Contractive Feedback Semantics for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zuyuan Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a compositional categorical semantics for discounted RL where infinite-horizon evaluation arises from contractive feedback closure. Yields theoretical results on component equivalence and modular reasoning.

entry.title: DriftingMol: Decoder-Coupled Drift for One-Pass Property-Conditional Molecular Generation

author.name: Jiangjie Qiu, Yijun Li, Wentao Li, Xiaonan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces DriftingMol, a two-stage framework adapting drifting models to a SELFIES latent molecular space for property-conditional generation. Achieves QED Spearman correlation of 0.493 on ZINC250K.

entry.title: T2S-MPC: Time-Embedded Online Adaptive Model Predictive Control for Time-Varying Dynamics

author.name: Zeyu Shen, Zhuoyuan Wang, Laixi Shi

entry.summary: Proposes T2S-MPC, an online adaptive MPC framework with time-embedded residual dynamics learning for general time-varying systems. Integrates temporal embedding with neural residual model for fast online planning.

entry.title: MedMamba: Multi-View State Space Models with Adaptive Graph Learning for Medical Time Series Classification

author.name: Da Zhang, Bingyu Li, Zhiyuan Zhao, Hongyuan Zhang, Junyu Gao, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Introduces MedMamba, an architecture combining state space models with multi-scale convolutions and adaptive graph learning for medical time series classification. Targets local-global dynamics and nonstationarity.

entry.title: Evolving Causal Regulatory Networks (ECR-Net)

author.name: Govind Vallabhasseri Binish, Abdhul Ahadh, Rano Roy Kavanal, Arya Ukunde

entry.summary: Introduces ECR-Net for adaptive causal mechanism discovery modeling data-generating processes as dynamic gene-regulatory-network-like systems. Targets non-static causal structures across environments.

entry.title: Learning Permutation from Structure Without Supervision

author.name: Ran Eisenberg, Ofir Lindenbaum

entry.summary: Studies unsupervised learning of permutations from structure using differentiable relaxations like Gumbel-Sinkhorn. Addresses non-uniform uncertainty in latent permutation learning beyond global temperature control.

entry.title: Courtroom Analogy: New Perspective on Uncertainty-Aware Classification

author.name: Taeseong Yoon, Heeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Introduces a courtroom analogy for uncertainty-aware classification, framing uncertainty as a structured debate among class-specific advocates aggregated via plausibility weights. Improves interpretability of single-pass UQ.

entry.title: Optimal and Order-optimal Gated Priority-based Greedy Policies for Two-layer Multi-item Order Fulfillment

author.name: Xi Chen, Yuze Chen, Ziyi Chen, Yuan Zhou

entry.summary: Develops gated priority-based greedy fulfillment policies for two-layer multi-item order fulfillment networks with theoretical near-optimality guarantees against optimal clairvoyant. Addresses scarce front DC inventory tradeoffs.

entry.title: STaT: Resolving Shape Distortion in Non-Stationary Time Series via Tri-Modal Synergy

author.name: Hui Cheng, Jinsheng Guo, Zhenhao Weng, Yan Qiao, Meng Li

entry.summary: Introduces STaT, a tri-modal architecture combining symbolic tokenization, temporal, and textual signals for non-stationary time series forecasting. Aims to avoid the over-smoothing problem of standard multimodal forecasters.

entry.title: Fuzzy PyTorch: Rapid Numerical Variability Evaluation for Deep Learning Models

author.name: In\'es Gonzalez-Pepe, Hiba Akhaddar, Tristan Glatard, Yohan Chatelain

entry.summary: Introduces Fuzzy PyTorch, a framework integrating stochastic arithmetic into PyTorch via the Verificarlo compiler for assessing numerical variability in deep learning models. Adds a novel up-down rounding mode.

entry.title: Towards Large Model Feature Coding

author.name: Youwei Pang, Changsheng Gao, Dong Liu, Huchuan Lu, Weisi Lin

entry.summary: Studies feature coding for large models in split execution scenarios, addressing the heterogeneity of features (multi-level, multi-modal, autoregressive caches) versus traditional CNN feature coding. Position/survey-like contribution.

entry.title: Detecting Metastable Basins in High Dimensions via Marginal Trajectory Distribution Discrimination

author.name: Taj Jones-McCormick

entry.summary: Discriminative approach for identifying metastable basins of attraction in high-dimensional Markov processes using only trajectory samples. Avoids spatial discretization or spectral analysis of transition operators.

entry.title: Physen-Noise2Noise: Physics-Guided Self-Supervised Defocus Deblurring with Bias Correction under Low-Light Conditions

author.name: Ziyan Huang, Lang Wu, Hongji Wang, Yifei Liu, Dongliang Tang, Hongqiao Wang

entry.summary: Physen-Noise2Noise is a self-supervised defocus deblurring framework incorporating defocus physics and a learnable noise bias parameter. Targets realistic low-light long-exposure imaging.

entry.title: Deep Learning-Enabled Prediction of Geoeffective CMEs Using SOHO and SDO Observations

author.name: Zhaoxin Yan, Jason T. L. Wang, Haimin Wang, Harim Lee, Ju Jing, Yan Xu, Chunhui Xu, Vasyl Yurchyshyn

entry.summary: Fusion model combining CNNs and prediction network for forecasting CME geoeffectiveness using SOHO LASCO and SDO AIA/HMI observations. Targets space weather impact prediction.

entry.title: SEED: Semi-supervised Continual MalwarE Detection for Tackling ConcEpt Drift on a BuDget

author.name: Suresh Kumar Amalapuram, Bikraj Shresta, Siva Ram murthy Chebiyam, Bheemarjuna Reddy Tamma, Sumohana S Channappayya

entry.summary: SEED is a semantic-structure-agnostic malware detection method under limited supervision combining tailored binary cross-entropy with continual/active learning components. Addresses degradation of HCL under partial labeling.

entry.title: ARCANE-PedSynth: Synthetic Multi-Pedestrian Datasets with Behavioural Crossing Annotations

author.name: Muhammad Naveed Riaz, Maciej Wielgosz, Antonio M. L\'opez Pe\~na

entry.summary: ARCANE-PedSynth is an open-source CARLA-based framework for generating synthetic multi-pedestrian datasets with behavioral crossing annotations. Achieves configurable crossing rates up to 75% with FSM-driven archetypes.

entry.title: Self-Balancing Gradient Allocation for Heterogeneity-Aware Feature Generation in Click-Through Rate Prediction

author.name: Moyu Zhang, Yun Chen, Yujun Jin, Jinxin Hu, Yu Zhang, Xiaoyi Zeng

entry.summary: HeteGenCTR addresses gradient imbalance in generative CTR prediction with discrete diffusion by adaptively weighting per-field reconstruction difficulty. Targets a real practical limitation in industrial recommender systems.

entry.title: Convex-Neural RRT*: Fast and Reliable Learning-Guided Sampling for High-Quality Robot Path Planning

author.name: Hichem Cheriet, Badra Khellat Kihel, Samira Chouraqui, Bara J. Emran

entry.summary: Convex-Neural RRT* uses neural networks to predict informative waypoint regions and extracts convex candidate areas for faster sampling-based robot path planning. Compared against several RRT* variants across three environments.

entry.title: QML-PipeGuard: Drift-Aware Behavioral Fingerprinting for Quantum Machine Learning Pipeline Integrity

author.name: Esra Yeniaras

entry.summary: QML-PipeGuard is a contract-based framework for verifying quantum machine learning pipeline integrity, addressing both hardware drift and adversarial channel substitution attacks. Aims at deployed cloud QML services in regulated industries.

entry.title: PQDT: Pseudo-Query Dual Transformer for Robust Point Cloud Restoration

author.name: Haoqing Wu, Alexa Nawotki, Jochen Garcke

entry.summary: PQDT is a Pseudo-Query Dual Transformer for unified 3D point cloud restoration, handling completion, denoising, and density irregularities. Avoids bottleneck features that lose fine-grained geometry.

entry.title: Decoding Stimulus Reconstruction-Based Auditory Attention Robustly in Unbalanced EEG Datasets

author.name: Yuanming Zhang, Yayun Liang, Zhibin Lin, Jing Lu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that stimulus-reconstruction-based auditory attention decoders overestimate performance on unbalanced EEG datasets and proposes a leave-one-paired-envelope-out cross-validation protocol to address this. Evaluates on three public EEG-AAD datasets.

entry.title: 3D Magnetic Field Reconstruction and Mapping with Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Haohan Yu, Zhanxu Hao, Bingzhi Li, Zejia Lu, Xiang Chen, Liang Li

entry.summary: Physics-Informed Neural Network framework for 3D magnetic field reconstruction with explicit residual losses at measurement locations and Maxwell equations in the loss. Targets high-precision physics experiments.

entry.title: StrTransformer: Source-Wise Structured Transformers for Unsupervised Blind Source Recovery

author.name: Yuan-Hao Wei

entry.summary: StrTransformer directly optimizes latent source matrices with structured Transformer branches for unsupervised blind source recovery, using multi-scale patch tokens and masked reconstruction as structural priors. Avoids encoder-based latent inference.

entry.title: Improving the Completeness and Comparability of Segment Disclosures: A Large Language Model Approach

author.name: Yue Liu, Zhiyuan Cheng, Longying Lai

entry.summary: Uses an LLM-based framework to extract segment-level disclosures from 10-K filings, improving completeness and comparability over structured databases for financial research. Addresses gaps in nested segment disclosures across firms.

entry.title: Toxicity in Twitch Chats: An LLM-Based Analysis Across Gaming Communities

author.name: Ronja Fuchs, Florian Rupp, Timo Bertram, Kai Eckert, Alexander Dockhorn

entry.summary: Analyzes ~20M Twitch chat messages across 4,452 streams and 7 gaming genres using zero-shot LLM classification of Twitch's toxicity taxonomy. Reaches F1 94.5% on TextDetox; characterizes toxicity differences across gaming communities.

entry.title: Translators as Invisible Teachers of AI: Copyright, Translation Memory, and the Political Economy of Linguistic Data

author.name: Masaru Yamada

entry.summary: Critical/political-economy analysis of how translation memories and parallel corpora from translators became foundational AI training data without compensation. Examines copyright and labor implications.

entry.title: Overview of the PsyDefDetect Shared Task at BioNLP 2026: Detecting Levels of Psychological Defense Mechanisms in Supportive Conversations
